div.p: Welcome back, ! Here's what's happening with your properties.

div.style: background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--owner-success-light) 0%, var(--owner-teal-light) 100%); color: var(--owner-teal);

div.t-att-data-chart-data: json.dumps({'available': available_units or 0, 'rented': rented_units or 0, 'sold': sold_units_count or 0})

div.t-attf-class: contract-days-badge {{ 'urgent' if contract.get('days_remaining', 0) <= 7 else 'warning' if contract.get('days_remaining', 0) <= 15 else 'normal' }}

div.t-attf-style: background-color: {{ 'var(--owner-info-light)' if req.state == 'new' else 'var(--owner-warning-light)' if req.state == 'in_progress' else 'var(--owner-success-light)' }}; color: {{ 'var(--owner-info)' if req.state == 'new' else 'var(--owner-warning)' if req.state == 'in_progress' else 'var(--owner-success)' }};
